messages.subject: Input & Output components suggestion
parts:
As I use Shiny more I think there should be a new type of component that is an input as well as an output. Currently some input components have update methods and of course we can use renderUI to achieve this effect. But I think it's better to have a a natural class components that can act as both input and output.

I am building an app where the output is a table. The user can dynamically change the component table and I would like to read the table as input and make further adjustments. Specifically the app can build a model using say logistic regression and the user can replace variables in the front end and refit the model using the updated list of variables.
